name: le-fabrique
description: Fábrica de software com controle e execução em uma VPS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/runtime && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/api && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/worker && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/web
scripts.test: node --test scripts/dev.test.mjs scripts/db.test.mjs scripts/claude-preflight.test.mjs scripts/evidence-backup-cli.test.mjs && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/runtime && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/api && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/worker && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/api && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/worker && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/web && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run typecheck:integration
scripts.test:redis: npm run build -w @le-fabrique/api && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/worker && node --test scripts/factory-pause.redis.test.mjs
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/runtime
